case: Scalar custom-enum CSV export and typed restore preserve boundary whitespace
contract: CSV export and parser retain the leading space in the enum label ' leading'.
CSV export and parser retain the trailing space in the enum label 'trailing '.
Typed CSV restore stores both labels exactly and reports the qualified PostgreSQL enum type.
Blank CSV cells remain ambiguous between an empty enum label and SQL NULL unless an explicit NULL marker is set.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_csv_round_trip_preserves_labels_and_sql_null -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum CSV quoting, search_path, session mode, and broader B3 combinations remain tracked separately.
